text:
Create the NEXT complete animation drawing after this near-hand-release pose. Keep the same right-facing camera, body/head scale, KH2 costume, cel shading, planted boots and canvas placement. The near/front hand stays EMPTY beside the waist with its clean plain glove; both complete arms remain visible.




Make one clear small lift with the FAR holding arm: bend that far elbow more and raise its gripping wrist together with the whole rigid Kingdom Key from the waist toward the LOWER CHEST, about one glove-width upward (roughly22px in512px coordinates). The gold guard is visibly higher relative to the belt than in the reference. Redraw the holding forearm naturally to connect the new wrist. Keep torso/head/hips and boot soles nearly stationary for this early arm transfer.




Move pommel, black grip, gold guard, blue collar, straight silver shaft and crown TOGETHER as the same rigid weapon, retaining their exact geometry/length and nearly the same diagonal up-left angle. The tip also rises the same distance with safe top margins; chain remains attached to the raised pommel and hangs down. Do not keep the guard at its old waist height, separate the blade from the grip, add a second gripping hand or put a wheel on the empty glove. This is only the FIRST small lift, BEFORE vertical blade and far-shoulder carry. Deliver ONE finished full sprite on white, no labels, sheet, effects or separate layers.
